### Description

Improve the official `gh` skill by documenting how to pass values safely through
`gh api`. Agents frequently mishandle `-f/-F`: raw field sends literal
strings without type conversion or `@` expansion; typed field converts
`true/false/null` numbers, expands `{owner}/{repo}/{branch}` from remotes,
and reads from file when the value starts with `@`. This causes accidental
file reads and failed mutations. The existing section also lacked guidance
about body ambiguity and verification read-back.

Closes #14701
